notes: Wisconsin's statewide honor-choir program is the WSMA State Honors Music Project, run by the Wisconsin School Music Association (NOT by WMEA, which is a separate partner organization). There are two levels: High School State Honors (grades 9-11, five ensembles including Mixed Choir and Treble Choir) and Middle Level State Honors (grades 6-8). Both perform at the Wisconsin State Music Conference in the Madison area in late October. SEASON LABELING: WSMA labels each cycle by the calendar year of its performance, and the cycles straddle school years — the '2026' high school cycle auditioned in February 2026, camps in June 2026, and performs in late October 2026. This file uses WSMA's own year labels. The 2027 high school audition information had not been posted at the retrieval date (WSMA states it posts September 1). The 2027 Middle Level audition dates and locations ARE published, with clock times. Note the middle level eligibility text references 'October 30 & October 31' rehearsals without a year; the year is not stated on the page so it is not asserted here.

organization.name: Wisconsin School Music Association
organization.description: WSMA is a 501(c)(3) organization that runs Wisconsin's concert festivals, solo & ensemble festivals, marching band activity, composition project, and the State Honors Music Project. The State Honors Music Project offers musically accomplished students the opportunity to rehearse and perform with nationally known conductors in a professional setting; all Honors groups perform at the Wisconsin State Music Conference. WSMA's partner organizations include the Wisconsin Music Educators Association and the Wisconsin Foundation for School Music.

programs.name: WSMA High School State Honors Mixed Choir
programs.description: The Mixed Choir of the WSMA High School State Honors Music Project, one of five high school honors ensembles. Selected students attend a mandatory four-day summer camp in June where the core musical preparation takes place, then perform in Madison during late October as part of the Wisconsin State Music Conference.

requirements.title: Grades 9, 10 or 11 at a WSMA-member school
requirements.description: The project is open to students from WSMA-member schools who are currently in grades 9, 10, or 11.

requirements.title: Regular member of a school music ensemble
requirements.description: Students must be a regular member of a school music ensemble during both the time of auditions and the fall performance.

requirements.title: Mandatory attendance at camp and concert
requirements.description: All selected students must attend both the full four-day June summer camp and the fall concert in Madison.

requirements.title: Prepared solo from the WSMA Festival Music List
requirements.description: All students must prepare a solo selected from the WSMA Festival Music List.

requirements.title: Required scales
requirements.description: Required scales are part of every audition; specific requirements are given in the full audition guidelines.

requirements.title: Sight-reading component
requirements.description: A sight-reading component is required. WSMA notes that the specific etude is the only element that changes each year.

fees.description: $610.00 tuition, including summer and fall rehearsals, coaching, all meals and lodging, fall transportation, music, a WSMA State Honors t-shirt, and a downloadable recording of the final concert. Tuition grants are available in limited number through the Wisconsin Foundation for School Music and WSMA.

programs.name: WSMA High School State Honors Treble Choir
programs.description: The Treble Choir of the WSMA High School State Honors Music Project. Same audition process, camp, and October Madison performance as the Mixed Choir.

programs.name: WSMA Middle Level State Honors Music Project — Choir
programs.description: The choral component of WSMA's Middle Level State Honors Music Project. Middle Level State Honors students receive their music in August and meet for the first time the day before their fall performance; the rehearsal day and formal concert take place in the Madison area as part of the Wisconsin State Music Conference. WSMA has published 2027 audition dates and locations.

requirements.title: Grades 6, 7, 8 at the time of the audition, from a WSMA-member school
requirements.description: Students in grades 6, 7, 8 (at the time of the audition) from WSMA-member schools are eligible to audition. Students must be a regular member of a school music ensemble at the time of auditions and the fall performance.

requirements.title: Mandatory rehearsal and concert attendance
requirements.description: All selected students must be able to attend the October 30 and October 31 rehearsals, activities and events. WSMA does not state the year on this page.

fees.description: Tuition for 2026: $305, including all meals, lodging, coaching, music, a WSMA State Honors t-shirt, State Honors pin, and a downloadable audio recording of the entire concert. This is the 2026 figure; WSMA had not published a 2027 tuition amount at the retrieval date. Limited tuition assistance grants are available through the Wisconsin Foundation for School Music and WSMA.
